text:
anya: Quick WFH PSA — my fiber went out this morning and the only stable place for the router was... the linen closet. photos: https://imgur.com/a/closet-chaos (two pics)
anya: had to string ethernet through the laundry gap. router is now wedged between towels. :sweat_smile:
matt: omg photos are glorious. are your towels acting as a Faraday cage? :joy:
anya: apparently towels + cat = new mesh node. follow-up: cat now insists on sitting on the router heat sink. :cat2:
jules: pro tip: put a short ethernet loop around the door frame and drop the cable under the door instead of through the dryer vent. less lint drama.
sam: had a similar move — neighbor did construction and killed our line last month. i tethered my phone as a backup but caps at 15Mbps. did an iperf quick test:
```
iperf3 -c 1.1.1.1
[ ID] Interval           Transfer     Bandwidth
[  5]   0.00-10.00  sec  17.8 MBytes  14.9 Mbits/sec
```
sam: basically enough for Slack & most calls but no video quality. :raising_hand:
leo: @anya love the towel aesthetic. do you have a surge protector in there? lint + power = nope.
anya: no surge (will add), but added a sticky cable clip so the cat can't drag the cable out. also turned on QoS for calls. small wins.
ops-bot: Incident notice: reported outage to ISP? (Y/N) — use /ispsupport to escalate.
anya: @ops-bot called support, ticket #51234. engineer scheduled for tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
matt: poll — who does the weirdest router placement? 1) Under desk 2) In closet 3) On top of fridge 4) On houseplant
jules: 2! (closet twin)
sam: 1 for me. under the desk fortress.
leo: 4. my philodendron and i have an understanding.
anya: closet for now. will update if cat melts the towels.
matt: please post final state-of-router photo for the archive. :camera_with_flash: (required reading)
